name: Hybrid solvent gas treating (Sulfinol)
applications: sour gas with mercaptans and COS
principle: A mixed solvent of an amine and the physical solvent sulfolane, in water. In Shell's current Sulfinol the amine is activated MDEA (MDEA with piperazine). The chemical part holds CO2 and H2S at low partial pressure; the physical part also takes up organic sulfur (mercaptans, COS), which pure amines miss, so one unit meets H2S, CO2 and organic sulfur specifications.

performance.metric: treated gas H2S at NAM Emmen
performance.basis: Sulfinol-M (MDEA plus sulfolane); sour gas H2S about 0.1 to 1 vol%, CO2 2 to 5 vol%, mercaptans up to 90 ppmv
